headline: South Korea probes suspected AI-powered bank cyberattacks
summary: South Korea's financial regulator is investigating a series of cyberattacks on banks suspected of using AI, with the president citing signs AI was used and tomshardware reporting data from about 25,000 customers was exposed.

claims.statement: South Korean authorities are investigating cyberattacks on financial institutions suspected of involving AI.

sources.quote: South Korea probes bank breaches amid suspected AI-powered attacks
Hackers suspected of using AI agents for cyberattacks on South Korean banks

claims.statement: South Korea's president told his cabinet there were signs AI was used to carry out the attacks.

sources.quote: South Korean president Lee Jae Myung told his cabinet that there were signs that hackers used AI to execute the attacks on the banks.

claims.statement: The attacks exposed data from about 25,000 customers.

discrepancies.explanation: tomshardware reports a specific customer-data exposure figure that bleepingcomputer's text does not mention.

quotes.quote: South Korea's Financial Services Commission (FSC) held an emergency meeting following a series of cyberattacks targeting financial institutions in the country.
